statements.status_notes: JwtRequestCodeFilter can fetch a JWT from an insufficiently validated request_uri, enabling denial of service against an authorization service. The scanner maps CXF core, JAX-RS frontend and HTTP transport base components. Whether Liberty applications use that OAuth filter and accept the relevant untrusted URI remains unverified. Open Liberty 26.0.0.11 ships this code inside vendor-assembled bundles. Changing a standalone library dependency does not replace that bundled implementation; a compatible vendor release or validated bundle remediation and application-specific applicability assessment remain unresolved. A base-version scanner match alone does not establish exploitability. See https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-7q4h-pj78-j7vg.

The CXF /services listing can reflect a malicious styleSheetPath into a page, enabling cross-site scripting. The scanner associates the CXF core, JAX-RS frontend and HTTP transport base components with this report. Whether the affected service-list page and parameter handling are exposed by configured Liberty applications remains unverified.
